answer: Let trust propagate from independently rooted attestations through walks capped at \(k\) steps, with voting weight proportional to the probability mass reached. A sybil cluster joined to honest nodes by a sparse cut has low conductance, so only a bounded fraction of walk mass can enter it before termination; its aggregate weight is therefore limited by cut leakage, not by the number of identities it creates. The timber of honest attestations, rather than a whisper of self-endorsement, anchors the nebula of new accounts.
